First of all, I am going to load in flowWorkspace and ggcyto packages:

```{r}
library(flowWorkspace)
library(ggcyto)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
```
Now, I have to indicate the file path and the files that I am going to use (I am going to use just the fcs files)

```{r}
StorageLocation <- file.path("C:/Users/Macarena/CytometryInR/course/07_Transformations/data")
fcs_files <- list.files(StorageLocation, ".fcs", full.names=TRUE)
SFC_files <- fcs_files[stringr::str_detect(fcs_files, "2025")]
```

```{r}
SFC_files
```

Next, I'm going to list the transformer objects
```{r}
SFC_cytoset <- load_cytoset_from_fcs(SFC_files, truncate_max_range=FALSE, transformation=FALSE)
SFC_GatingSet <- GatingSet(SFC_cytoset)
SFC_GatingSet
```
A GatingSet with 6 samples

And I'm going to apply transformers

```{r}
Logicle <- logicle_trans()
str(Logicle)
```

I am going to plot the FSC-A and SSC-A to see what happens...
```{r}
ggcyto(SFC_GatingSet[6], subset="root", aes(x="FSC-A", y="SSC-A")) + geom_hex(bins=100)
```

# Problem 2
Let's visualize the same fluorophores that we follow during the course:

```{r}
ggcyto(SFC_GatingSet[6], subset="root", aes(x="BUV805-A", y="BV650-A")) + geom_hex(bins=100)
```

![](C:/Users/Macarena/CytometryInR/course/07_Transformations/homeworks/MacarenaLM-week07/ggplot2 default.png)

Let's change width

```{r}
SFC_cytoset <- load_cytoset_from_fcs(SFC_files, truncate_max_range=FALSE, transformation=FALSE)
SFC_GatingSet <- GatingSet(SFC_cytoset)
Biexponential <- flowjo_biexp_trans(channelRange=4096, maxValue=262144, pos=4.5, neg=0, widthBasis=-500)
MyBiexTransform <- transformerList(FluorophoresAndMore, Biexponential)
transform(SFC_GatingSet, MyBiexTransform)
```

A GatingSet with 6 samples

Let's investigate how works this function:
```{r}
?logicle_trans
```

Now, I'm going to stablish the GatingSet with the default settings:
```{r}
SFC_cytoset <- load_cytoset_from_fcs(SFC_files, truncate_max_range = FALSE, transformation = FALSE)
SFC_GatingSet <- GatingSet(SFC_cytoset)
Logicle <- logicle_trans(FluorophoresAndMore, n=6, equal.space=FALSE)
MyBiexTransform <- transformerList(FluorophoresAndMore, Logicle)
transform(SFC_GatingSet, MyBiexTransform)
```
A GatingSet with 6 samples

```{r}
ggcyto(SFC_GatingSet[6], subset="root", aes(x="BUV805-A", y="BV650-A")) + geom_hex(bins=100)
```
![](C:/Users/Macarena/CytometryInR/course/07_Transformations/homeworks/MacarenaLM-week07/ggplot2 LogicleDefault.png)

Next, let's change equal.space to TRUE:
```{r}
SFC_cytoset <- load_cytoset_from_fcs(SFC_files, truncate_max_range = FALSE, transformation = FALSE)
SFC_GatingSet <- GatingSet(SFC_cytoset)
Logicle <- logicle_trans(FluorophoresAndMore, n=6, equal.space=TRUE)
MyBiexTransform <- transformerList(FluorophoresAndMore, Logicle)
transform(SFC_GatingSet, MyBiexTransform)
```
A GatingSet with 6 samples

```{r}
ggcyto(SFC_GatingSet[6], subset="root", aes(x="BUV805-A", y="BV650-A")) + geom_hex(bins=100)
```
![](C:/Users/Macarena/CytometryInR/course/07_Transformations/homeworks/MacarenaLM-week07/ggplot2 EqSpaceTRUE.png)

And now, I am also applying a change in n (lower value)
```{r}
SFC_cytoset <- load_cytoset_from_fcs(SFC_files, truncate_max_range = FALSE, transformation = FALSE)
SFC_GatingSet <- GatingSet(SFC_cytoset)
Logicle <- logicle_trans(FluorophoresAndMore, n=2, equal.space=TRUE)
MyBiexTransform <- transformerList(FluorophoresAndMore, Logicle)
transform(SFC_GatingSet, MyBiexTransform)
```
